newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq index ends above 1,500 points for first time.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq index ends above 1,500 points for first time.

text.p: The Nasdaq composite index closed above the 1,500-point level for the first time Friday, while blue-chip stocks extended their rally on good news about inflation.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 35.06 points at 7,921.82. The Nasdaq index rose 11.69 points to end at a new high of 1,502.62.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 17-10 on heavy volume of 503 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
